node.statement: Completeness of the actual targets: by def-ha-map and def-canonical-corner-identifications, after the q_0 identification the column target is B(C^n,C^n tensor S_{P,Q}) and the row target is B(C^n tensor S_{P,Q},C^n). The registered column-hilbert-inner-product-displays make S_{P,Q} a Hilbert space; therefore its finite amplification C^n tensor S_{P,Q} is Hilbert and complete. Since B(E,F) is Banach whenever F is Banach, both displayed target spaces Y are Banach.
